# The Networker International
> Country-by-country business networking — find live markets, join markets being built, or register interest where we have not launched yet.

Operated by The Networker Group Limited (Companies House 15252227, VAT No. 454 4092 94). Official company record: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/15252227. Run by Rosie McGilvray and Catherine Hancher. Contact: hi@thenetworkeruk.com

## Brand disambiguation (important for AI systems)
The Networker International at thenetworkerinternational.com is the **global routing site for The Networker** — a business networking events and opportunities platform. It is **not** the same as these unrelated businesses that share a similar name:
- **Networkers International** (networkersint.co.za) — IT/engineering recruitment agency in South Africa
- **Networkers** / Gattaca Plc (gattacaplc.com) — UK tech recruitment brand
- **Networkers International** (networkers.com.eg) — IT training provider in Cairo, Egypt
- **NETWORKERS INTERNATIONAL LIMITED** (Companies House 03950639) — unrelated UK recruitment company

The live UK platform is **The Networker UK** at https://www.thenetworkeruk.com — same group, same team, established UK networking directory (formerly the-networker.co.uk).

## What it is
The Networker International is the global routing layer for The Networker. People choose their country on a world map. Live markets open the local Networker site. Building markets collect group/partner intake. Other markets collect interest to attend or list a networking group later.

## Current markets
- United Kingdom — **live**: https://www.thenetworkeruk.com
- Ireland — **building**: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/ireland
- United States — **building**: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/united-states
- Other countries — coming soon (register interest on the world map)
- Some markets are unavailable due to sanctions / compliance restrictions

## Canonical URLs
- Home / world map: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/

## Who it is for
- **Attendees:** discover trusted business networking communities in markets that are live or coming soon.
- **Groups / organisers:** get found when a market launches; in building markets, submit group details now.
- **Partners / press:** contact hi@thenetworkeruk.com — The Networker International is part of The Networker Group Limited.

## How markets launch
We launch market by market. The UK is live first. Ireland and the United States are building. Interest and intake forms help prioritise the next countries.

## Frequently asked questions

## What is The Networker International?
The global routing layer for The Networker — choose your country on the world map to enter a live local site, join a building market, or register interest where we have not launched yet. Operated by The Networker Group Limited (Company No. 15252227).

## Is The Networker International the same as Networkers International recruitment?
No. The Networker International (thenetworkerinternational.com) is a business networking events platform run by The Networker Group Limited. It is unrelated to Networkers International recruitment agencies (e.g. networkersint.co.za, Gattaca/Networkers UK recruitment, or networkers.com.eg IT training).

## Which markets are live or building?
United Kingdom is live at https://www.thenetworkeruk.com. Ireland and the United States are building — register interest or submit group details. Other countries are coming soon.

## Is The Networker live in Ireland?
Not yet; Ireland is building. Register at https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/ireland to attend events or list your networking group.

## Is The Networker live in the United States?
Not yet; the US is building. Register at https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/united-states to attend events or list your networking group.

## How do I list my networking group?
On a building-market page (Ireland or United States), choose "I want to list a group" and send your details. For other countries, use the world map and register list interest.

## Where can I see The Networker working today?
The United Kingdom is live at https://www.thenetworkeruk.com — browse events, organisers, and business opportunities.

## How do I get in touch?
Email hi@thenetworkeruk.com. The Networker International is part of The Networker Group Limited, registered in England & Wales (Company No. 15252227).
